_comment: Numbers the GDD specifies but the spreadsheet's Assumptions sheet does not (yet) carry. Merged into balance.json by balance-from-xlsx.ts. Sheet values always win on a key clash. Move a number into the sheet when a designer wants to tune it there. NOTE (M4, 2026-09-08): local dog ratings lifted from M0's 28/42/52 to 30/46/58 and the Bronze/Silver purses raised in the sheet to pay for it, so that racing a dog up a class is a gamble rather than a free option (GDD §19, PLAYTEST_NOTES finding 1). GDD §6.1's 35/57/78 was measured and rejected: with locals that strong no stable wins a Gold at all, every dog is forced into its lowest class and mean end worth collapses to ~17k. itemSupplementBonus raised 8 -> 12 (finding 2): at +8 the supplement was worth feeding in 10% of real declarations, which is a trap rather than a choice. NOTE (v2 Phase A, 2026-09-11): the nine GDD §6.2 race-simulation constants moved out of here and into the Assumptions sheet (D12) — they decide which of the four stats is worth feeding, so they belong where a designer can sweep them. oddsScale refitted 17.5 -> 15.5 with the §6.2 constants (GDD §20 Q4): the rebalance made the sim steeper in rating, and 15.5 minimises the worst-case error across ratings 35-75 (2.1 points) while leaving the bookie a small, stable under-pricing of the very best dogs — the divergence Phase D's crook works against, small enough that backing favourites blind still loses to the margin.
